fpi.name: FAO Food Price Index
fpi.limitation: International export-weighted price indices, not domestic retail prices. Recent meat index includes projected and observed quotations and can be revised.

psd.name: USDA Production, Supply and Distribution
psd.licence: US federal government public data; attribution
psd.limitation: Marketing-year estimates and forecasts; not FAO calendar-year observations. Provider country names and quantities retained. Do not infer actual stock availability.

geoglam.name: GEOGLAM Crop Monitor
geoglam.limitation: Dated official spatial assessments, not measured yield losses. Layer metadata only; no region-level extraction or risk inference.

gdacs.name: Global Disaster Awareness and Coordination System
gdacs.limitation: Recent provider hazard notifications, not confirmed agricultural damage or an exhaustive disaster inventory. Alert level belongs to GDACS, not GFSO. Confirm with local authorities before decisions.
